upstream.model_card: https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI: license: mit in the card metadata; the card has no other text.
upstream.hubert_base: Presumed to be ContentVec (https://github.com/auspicious3000/contentvec, MIT, Copyright (c) 2019), which RVC's README credits; ContentVec is built on fairseq's HuBERT (https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq, MIT). Neither lj1995 nor RVC states which ContentVec checkpoint this is or where the Transformers-format hubert_base folder (added 2026-07-19) comes from; hubert_base.pt in the same repository is a fairseq checkpoint. ContentVec's repository licenses its code; it gives no separate terms for the checkpoints it links to, and the terms of the training data were not checked.
upstream.rmvpe: RMVPE (https://github.com/Dream-High/RMVPE, Apache-2.0 for the code). RVC's README says the pretrained model was trained and tested by yxlllc and RVC-Boss; no separate terms for the weights were found, and yxlllc/RMVPE no longer exists. rmvpe.onnx was uploaded to lj1995 on 2023-10-06.

note: The app fetches the three files under files from the pinned revision after the user agrees on the RVC runtime setup screen (src-python/models/voice_conversion/runtime_setup.py), and checks size and SHA-256. They are never bundled. earlier_files are what the earlier PyTorch runtime fetched; the app still knows them only to remove them (EARLIER_RVC_FILES). The speaker model is supplied by the user and must never be bundled.
consent: 2026-10-29: explicit user consent for hubert_base/config.json, hubert_base/preprocessor_config.json, hubert_base/pytorch_model.bin and rmvpe.pt (local Mia2026 validation). No redistribution approval.

2026-11-15: rmvpe.onnx from the same revision added to the app's fetch with the bundled RVC worker (#275 Phase 3, PR #312, merged after the owner's review). Size and SHA-256 rechecked against the Hugging Face API on 2026-11-15. No redistribution approval.
